task: Harden Koala validation, CLI argument errors, DONE preflight guidance, and generated story artifact handling without project-specific hardcoding.
outcome: A user runs koala validate --json and sees the actual configured command with shell/code/durationMs, runs a bad checklist_update enum and sees the exact invalid field path instead of a help-only fallback, runs koala next in TEST and sees blocking DONE pre-check rows before any DONE suggestion, and koala doctor explains validation fallback risks without relying on PVSC-specific counts.
facts: Existing validation command discovery already supports shell=true for configured string commands containing shell metacharacters.
Existing CLI schema validation already prints Zod issue paths and expected enum values for verificationIntent type failures.
Existing session_brief and next already consume DONE pre-check rows for TEST phase in flow-stability smoke tests.
Existing stray-file cleanup whitelist already contains init-self-check.json.
Product INIT reviewer passed but asked CHK-005 to expose clearer user-observable value.
constraints: Do not hard-code PVSC, story ids, or exact pytest counts in Koala runtime logic.
Preserve current Koala lifecycle gates and do not bypass reviewer or delivery checks.
Keep human safety for unknown untracked story files; only Koala-generated precise artifact names may be cleaned.
New validation behavior must fail hard for required command failures and keep optional failures advisory only.
Follow fail-fast policy for new catches: no naked silent catch in mutation/persistence paths.
